rows.verdictEvidence: On a production build (no HMR document reload), the row's setOffline window burns the lobby client's two reconnect attempts. After setOffline(false) both pages stay on multiplayer-unavailable-panel with RECONNECT_LIMIT and a leftover 'No internet connection' toast. The letter of E2E-15 (spec.md: E2E-15 restart restores full authority — campaign, match, participants, receipts, cursors, pending outbox, and authorized projections SHALL recover before new commands are enabled) still wants commands enabled; the row's own offline construction is what prevents the banner from mounting. The regex is not rejecting a real posture such as pending.
rows.letterVsRow: The row is wrong as an assertion method, not as a letter: sqlite recovery already happened; commandsEnabled never becomes observable because the client has closed. A production in-paths fix is to reload (or remount) after connectivity returns, which the pack header already records as the recovery path HMR used to provide. A product retry after RECONNECT_LIMIT when the network returns would also unstick it but is outside U3 paths.

firstBadCommit.whyNotBisected: reproduction settled the mechanism. setOffline is in the original E2E-15 commit ecb2d8cad (#1494, 2026-09-02). RECONNECT_LIMIT exists since 95c837b03 (2026-06-21). maxReconnectAttempts: 2 is on the lobby page. The 2026-09-02 green claim in tasks.md:541 was consistent with the pack header's dev-HMR reload; this production run has no HMR.

proposedFix.what: After setOffline(false) and waitForServerBack, reload both pages (or otherwise remount the lobby session) before polling the banner, and keep the sqlite recovery clauses where they are. Do not widen COMMANDS_ENABLED_STATES to pending. Optionally raise the poll to also accept a documented reconnecting window, but the letter wants commands enabled, so live|finalized after a reload is the honest in-paths close.
